title: OL-20261115-15: workers#173 Worker backlog has no doer: deploy and probe
body:
**Owner:** ROWAN (identity-bound: Cloudflare account access)
**Trigger:** Worker deployed
**Done check:** grep:docs/PROJECT-MEMORY.md::claims_released_unworked_24h 0
**Status:** closed

Moved from ultrastable/workers#173. Code merged in workers#188: execute tick step closes dispatched items whose probe the tick can read. Remaining: deploy this Worker to the ultrastable Cloudflare account (NEEDS-YOU cloudflare-new-account), then /health shows claims_released_unworked_24h 0 (reference Worker read 34 on 2026-11-15).

**Disposition:** gate (owner-bound, 2026-11-20T20:46:50Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** owner field 'ROWAN (identity-bound: Cloudflare account access)' binds this to the owner's own account, money or signature, which no server-side loop holds. Default in effect: the system runs without this step; nothing waits on it. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes.
